name: Calculation Method 1 Code
definition: Indicates if the method for interest calculation is simple or compounding.

SIMP.name: Simple
SIMP.definition: Calculation method by which interest is calculated on the original principal only. Accumulated interest from prior periods is not used in calculations for the following periods.

COMP.name: Compounding
COMP.definition: Calculation method by which interest is calculated each period on the original principal and all interest accumulated during past periods.
